triplets.head: Joint vetoes (post-Cold War)
triplets.tail: Every single one was China + Russia

triplets.head: S/2007/14 (Myanmar joint veto)
triplets.tail: No SC action; UN Human Rights Council special sessions; ASEAN-led engagement; Saffron Revolution (2007) crushed by junta

triplets.head: S/2008/447 (Zimbabwe joint veto)
triplets.tail: SADC mediation (Mbeki); power-sharing agreement Sep 2008; US/EU bilateral sanctions

triplets.head: S/2011/612 (Syria civil war joint veto)
triplets.tail: Arab League suspended Syria (Nov 2011); Kofi Annan appointed Joint Special Envoy (Feb 2012)

triplets.head: S/2012/77 (Syria Arab League plan joint veto)
S/2012/77 (Syria Arab League plan joint veto)
triplets.tail: 19 countries including Bahrain, Colombia, Egypt, France, Germany, Jordan, Kuwait, Libya, Morocco, Oman, Portugal, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Togo, Tunisia, Turkey, UAE, UK, US

triplets.head: S/2012/77 (Syria Arab League plan joint veto)
S/2012/77 (Syria Arab League plan joint veto)
triplets.tail: GA passed A/RES/66/253; Annan Six-Point Plan launched; UNSMIS established briefly then withdrawn

triplets.head: S/2012/538 (Syria Chapter VII joint veto)
triplets.tail: Annan resigned Aug 2012, replaced by Brahimi; GA passed A/RES/66/253 B condemning Council failure

triplets.head: S/2014/348 (Syria ICC referral joint veto)
triplets.tail: 65 countries (France, UK, US + dozens of European, Arab, other states)

triplets.head: S/2014/348 (Syria ICC referral joint veto)
triplets.tail: No ICC referral achieved; GA created IIIM (Dec 2016) to preserve evidence; European states pursued universal jurisdiction; Germany convicted Anwar Raslan (2022)

triplets.head: S/2016/1026 (Syria Aleppo ceasefire joint veto)
triplets.tail: Aleppo fell to Assad forces Dec 2016; Russia-Turkey brokered Astana process (Jan 2017)

triplets.head: S/2017/172 (Syria chemical weapons joint veto)
triplets.tail: First of 5 chemical weapons vetoes in 2017; after JIM terminated, OPCW created Investigation and Identification Team (IIT) in June 2018 bypassing SC

triplets.head: S/2019/186 (Venezuela joint veto)
triplets.tail: Competing Russia draft also failed (4–7–4); 50+ countries recognized Guaidó; Council remained deadlocked

triplets.head: S/2019/756 (Syria Idlib ceasefire joint veto)
triplets.tail: ~1 million civilians displaced; Turkey-Russia bilateral ceasefire (Mar 2020)

triplets.head: S/2019/961 (Syria cross-border joint veto)
triplets.tail: Compromise Res. 2504 adopted Jan 2020 with only 2 crossings (down from 4), 6 months (down from 12)

triplets.head: S/2020/654 (Syria cross-border joint veto)
triplets.tail: Compromise Res. 2533 adopted 11 Jul 2020 — only 1 crossing (Bab al-Hawa), 12 months

triplets.head: S/2022/431 (North Korea sanctions joint veto)
triplets.tail: First-ever China-Russia veto of North Korea sanctions (breaking 15 years of consensus)

triplets.head: S/2022/431 (North Korea sanctions joint veto)
triplets.tail: GA debate under Res. 76/262; Mar 2024 Russia vetoed renewal of DPRK Sanctions Panel of Experts; US/allies imposed bilateral sanctions

triplets.head: S/2023/792 (Gaza humanitarian pauses joint veto)
triplets.tail: GA invoked 10th ESS; passed ES-10/21 (121-14-44: humanitarian truce) and ES-10/22 (153-10-23: humanitarian ceasefire)

triplets.head: S/2024/239 (Gaza ceasefire-hostage joint veto)
triplets.tail: E10 introduced own draft which became Res. 2728 (25 Mar 2024) — first Council resolution demanding immediate Gaza ceasefire; US abstained; Israel announced it would ignore Res. 2728

triplets.head: Alternative pathway after joint vetoes
triplets.tail: General Assembly resolutions (non-binding): Uniting for Peace sessions, creation of IIIM

triplets.head: Alternative pathway after joint vetoes
triplets.tail: Regional organization action: Arab League (Syria), SADC (Zimbabwe), ASEAN (Myanmar), Lima Group (Venezuela)

triplets.head: Alternative pathway after joint vetoes
triplets.tail: Bypassing Council via technical bodies: OPCW IIT (2018) for chemical weapons attribution

triplets.head: Alternative pathway after joint vetoes
triplets.tail: Bilateral/plurilateral sanctions: US/EU on Zimbabwe, Syria, Venezuela, North Korea

triplets.head: Alternative pathway after joint vetoes
triplets.tail: Watered-down compromise resolutions: Syria cross-border reduced from 4 to 2 to 1 crossing then expired

triplets.head: Alternative pathway after joint vetoes
triplets.tail: Parallel diplomatic tracks: Russia-Turkey Astana process (Syria), Turkey-Russia Idlib ceasefire

triplets.head: United States (December 2016 Obama)
triplets.tail: Abstained on Israeli settlements resolution — first time in decades

triplets.head: United States (March 2024)
triplets.tail: Abstained on Res. 2728 allowing first SC Gaza ceasefire demand to pass

triplets.head: ES-10/13

triplets.head: ES-10/14

triplets.head: ES-10/15

triplets.head: ES-10/16
triplets.tail: Deplores Gaza operations; Beit Hanoun fact-finding mission

triplets.head: ES-10/17

triplets.head: ES-10/18

triplets.head: ES-10/19

triplets.head: ES-10/20

triplets.head: ES-10/21

triplets.head: ES-10/22

triplets.head: ES-10/24

triplets.head: 11th Emergency Special Session
triplets.tail: Aggression against Ukraine / Russian invasion of Ukraine

triplets.head: 11th Emergency Special Session
triplets.tail: Security Council Resolution 2623 — first time in 40 years SC itself called for ESS

triplets.head: 11th Emergency Special Session
triplets.tail: Russia voted against but could not veto the procedural motion (vetoes only apply to substantive matters)

triplets.head: ES-11/1
triplets.tail: Deplores invasion; demands full Russian withdrawal

triplets.head: ES-11/3
triplets.tail: Suspension of Russia from Human Rights Council

triplets.head: ES-11/3
triplets.tail: Only second country ever suspended from HRC (after Libya 2011)

triplets.head: ES-11/4
triplets.tail: Declares Russia's referendums invalid; condemns annexation

triplets.head: ES-11/5
triplets.tail: Calls for Russia to pay war reparations

triplets.head: ES-11/6
triplets.tail: Comprehensive, just and lasting peace; withdraw to recognized borders

triplets.head: ES-11/9
triplets.tail: Return of forcibly transferred Ukrainian children

triplets.head: ES-11/10
triplets.tail: Immediate ceasefire; release detained persons; return civilians

triplets.head: 11th Emergency Special Session
triplets.tail: Declined from 141 in favor (2022) to 91–107 (2025–2026), suggesting growing fatigue/geopolitical realignment

triplets.head: GA emergency special sessions
triplets.tail: Resolutions are non-binding; Israel has ignored all 27 resolutions of 10th ESS; Russia has ignored all 10 resolutions of 11th ESS
